parts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished Japanese vertical-scroll manga comparison sample, part 1 of 2. Prefer 1024x3072 portrait; four full-width panels STACKED VERTICALLY ONLY, no side-by-side grid. Large quiet off-white gutters; varied panel heights. This is a SLOW single continuous conversation, not a montage of locations. No title, panel numbers, labels or watermark.
Input image 1: reference ONLY for Ren and Mira identities, clothes, exact drawing style, torn cargo awning and SAME location. DO NOT copy its two-balloon conversation density. All four panels are successive moments immediately after the soft cargo landing. White floating fantasy city, blue daylight; stay on SAME lower cargo plaza at ground level. Ren is unarmored, black spiky hair blue eyes black soft short-sleeve shirt brown straps charcoal trousers red scarf BARE hands, minor existing bruises; he stays kneeling/sitting low. Mira blonde loosely braided hair blue eyes white/blue/gold dress same jeweled flowers, safely upright beside him. Mira on right, Ren on left, stable eyelines.
Artwork: match reference crisp Japanese anime cel shaded style and expressive faces. Small quiet backgrounds, place only the speaker or attention target in close shots. Do not repaint a full cast or elaborate city in every panel. No new people, knight, giant, crystal apparatus, armor, glowing chest core, flashback, crown crest or new plot.
Lettering: dialogue AND smooth white speech balloons must be raster integrated. Genuine upright Japanese glyphs, top-to-bottom columns, columns RIGHT TO LEFT, exactly the listed text and punctuation. Large bold clean manga gothic; glyph height roughly 64px at 1024px wide, readable at 360px. Never shrink text to cram a conversation. Tails identify the real speaker; face, eyes and hands unobscured. Silent panels have NO text/balloons/sound effects. One principal perception or utterance per panel.
Panel 1 at top: shared medium view ONCE to orient. Ren kneels at LEFT, dust settles around torn tan cargo canvas and soft packages. Mira at RIGHT has her own two feet visibly planted on solid white stone; she steadies herself after being set down, her one hand lightly on Ren's shoulder. Ren's bare palm braces on ground. They make eye contact and confirm safety, exhausted rather than posing heroically. No dialogue. No landing replay.
Panel 2 below with a quiet gutter: close-up of MIRA ONLY, grateful soft gaze diagonally down toward Ren offscreen LEFT. Same blue eyes and flower braid. Background is just softly suggested torn canvas. Exact single speech balloon: ありがとう。 ONE vertical column.
Panel 3 below: close-up of REN ONLY, looks up RIGHT toward Mira, shoulders relax, lips closed, small relieved exhale shown by expression. Red scarf, soot/bruises. He has heard the thanks; no text or extra person. This is a brief listening reaction.
Panel 4 at bottom: medium close-up of MIRA ONLY, still looking down LEFT at Ren, one hand lightly touches her own chest to introduce herself. Same dress and gem, no elaborate skyline. Exact single speech balloon: 私はミラ。 ONE vertical column. Do not include the later princess statement or Ren reply.

parts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story, precise layout revision of a Japanese vertical-scroll manga.
Input image 1 is the edit target: retain its FOUR successive story moments, exact Japanese dialogue and same character expressions. Image 2 supplies the original character/style/setting reference ONLY. Preserve Ren and Mira identities, red scarf, black soft shirt, BARE hands, Mira white/blue/gold dress and flowers, same cargo plaza and daylight. No new characters, plot, armor, magic, giant, crown crest or text. They remain in the same place with Ren low on LEFT and Mira upright offscreen RIGHT when not visible.
Primary change: RECOMPOSE the four panels with STRONGLY DIFFERENT frame widths, heights and aspect ratios. This MUST visibly depart from four similar full-width rectangles. Prefer portrait 1024x3072 (roughly 3:1 tall); all panels read strictly TOP TO BOTTOM, never side by side. OFF-WHITE negative space and staggered left/right alignment connect the panels. Large first/last views, visibly narrower dialogue panels, and one VERY SHALLOW small silent reaction insert. Narrow panels must be newly composed for that space, NOT squashed or stretched. Keep faces and all dialogue unobscured.
Lettering: exact specified Japanese raster lettering and smooth white balloons integrated with art. Upright glyphs, columns top-to-bottom then RIGHT TO LEFT. LARGE printed manga gothic, readable at 360px whole-strip display. Speech panels stay about 80-90 percent page width so text doesn't become tiny. Silent reaction inserts have no text and focus on readable eyes rather than a tiny whole body. No panel numbers, captions, duplicate balloons or watermark.
TOP panel 1: the orientation beat. A LARGE full-page-width landscape/near-square frame (about 28 percent total page height). Mira's feet planted on solid stone, Ren kneeling low left with palm braced on ground, torn tan canvas and cargo; quiet eye contact confirms safety. This is the ONE shared view. No text. Enough room to understand the space.
After a moderate off-white vertical pause, panel 2: about 82 percent page WIDTH, offset RIGHT, portrait/near-square (about 21 percent total page height). MIRA ONLY face and shoulder, looks left-down, grateful. Single vertical dialogue: ありがとう。 Tail to Mira. Do not draw Ren.
After a short gutter, panel 3: a VERY SHALLOW HORIZONTAL INSERT about 60 percent page WIDTH, offset LEFT, ONLY 7-8 percent total page height, width at least twice its height. REN'S EYES and upper cheek close-up, soot/bruises, looking up-right; eyelids soften in relief. No mouth, full head or torso needed. SILENT. It must look clearly smaller and thinner than either neighbor, a brief listening glance.
After a generous quiet gap, panel 4: a LARGE almost-full-width PORTRAIT frame (about 30 percent total page height), visually much taller than panel 3. MIRA ONLY upper body, hand at own chest with familiar gem, looks down-left. Single vertical dialogue: 私はミラ。 Let her name land. No later princess line. All four frames have thin dark borders. The remaining page height is varied whitespace, not equal gutters.
